identity_chain.fact: CQC certificate CQC250920355034 register page16 row46 identifies 皓扬廊坊1号数据中心 at 河北省廊坊市固安县东方街27号 (No.27 Dongfang Street).

Operator development history identifies the 2019 38,227-square-metre Guan Fuai Electronics reused-factory project and explicitly records its May2021 renaming to Langfang No.1. The 2019 entry embeds the selected A/B/C/substation plan.

Operator plan labels buildings A and B side by side, research/support building C southeast, 110kV substation southwest, and Shidai Road along the east. The distinctive arrangement matches the operator campus rendering and georeferenced imagery.

Reviewed imagery shows the same two north-south blocks with repeated rooftop equipment arrays, southwest substation, southeast support building, and roads along east and south. The selected marker lies between the blocks; imagery is used for geometry only.

facts.source_coordinate_system: EPSG:4326 WGS84 longitude/latitude confirmed by the retained ArcGIS export response extent and spatialReference; pixel conversion uses the returned extent, width and height.

reviewed_registration.method: Unweighted affine least squares, eight manually selected corresponding A/B building outline corners; image-pixel coordinates use upper-left origin.
reviewed_registration.selected_marker_semantics: Approximate inter-building parent-campus marker between A and B; neither a surveyed centroid nor a phase footprint.
reviewed_registration.accuracy_limit: Fit residual is internal registration agreement, not ground accuracy. Plan is a 380x260 historic cropped drawing with upper building edges near crop boundary. Operator rendering and photographed roofs differ from ground footprints; roof displacement/parallax, source plan scale/change, manual corner choice, basemap geolocation and acquisition date are not independently bounded. Reference imagery is used only for spatial context, not lifecycle status.

reproduction.algorithm: For each image axis, solve (X transpose X) beta = X transpose y for X rows [plan_x, plan_y, 1] using unweighted least squares and Gauss-Jordan elimination with pivoting. Apply the resulting two affine coefficient triples to plan pixel [187,111]. Convert image pixels to the returned EPSG4326 extent with lon=xmin+(x+0.5)/width*(xmax-xmin); lat=ymax-(y+0.5)/height*(ymax-ymin). Round longitude and latitude to four decimal places.
reproduction.residual_definition: Internal Euclidean registration residual after local degree-to-metre scaling, using 111320 metres/degree and cosine(latitude) longitude scaling. RMS3.08m and maximum5.95m measure control fit only and are not an estimate of absolute ground accuracy.

independent_review.finding: Independent visual match passes for parent campus: two north-south data-center blocks side by side, southwest substation, southeast support building, road along east and southern frontage. No footprint, building completion or ground positional accuracy inferred.
independent_review.export_extent_verified: esri-export-extent.json confirms returned EPSG4326 extent equal to requested bbox and1400x1000 image. Root replayed eight-control affine fit byte for byte, mapped plan[187,111] to imagery[836.4079,517.6149] and rounded WGS84[116.2462,39.4604].
independent_review.precision: Approximate analyst-selected parent-campus point, four decimals, total accuracy unknown.
independent_review.source_selection: Esri georeferenced imagery as numeric geometry evidence; operator plan and CQC address as primary identity context. OSM only supplementary street context, not numeric geometry. Source imagery not redistributed.
independent_review.attribution: Source: Esri, Vantor, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community (captured service metadata).
independent_review.decision: Accept candidate campus locator and finalize geometry/source packet. Root independently viewed plan, rendering and imagery. Both the independently selected and fitted marker lie within same inter-building campus corridor; precision remains campus only, absolute accuracy unknown.

supplementary_spatial_check.scope_warning: Unlabelled community-mapped industrial polygon used as geometric consistency context only, not an independently named parcel, legal boundary or selected exported footprint. Area agreement is corroboration, not proof of identity.
